scripts.restart: npm run stop && npm run start
scripts.mcp:compare: sh -c 'test -n "$SLUG" || { echo "Set SLUG=..."; exit 1; }; curl -s -X POST "${COMPARE_BASE:-http://127.0.0.1:5173}/api/compare/${SLUG}" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"multi\":true,\"viewports\":\"all\",\"passDiffRatio\":0.02,\"screenshot\":{\"mode\":\"element\",\"selector\":\"#cmp_root\",\"minHeight\":50}}"'
scripts.mcp:refine: sh -c 'test -n "$SLUG" || { echo "Set SLUG=..."; exit 1; }; curl -s -X POST "${COMPARE_BASE:-http://127.0.0.1:5173}/api/refine/${SLUG}" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"provider\":\"visual-optimizer\",\"bucket\":\"desktop\",\"maxIters\":3,\"passDiffRatio\":0.02,\"topOffenders\":12}"'
scripts.mcp:preview:hi-fi: sh -c 'test -n "$FIGMA_URL" || { echo "Set FIGMA_URL=..."; exit 1; }; npm run mcp:build && node ../tools/figma2code-mcp/dist/cli.js ingest --desktop --url "$FIGMA_URL" ${SLUG:+--slug "$SLUG"} --mcp "${MCP_ENDPOINT:-http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp}" --post "${PREVIEW_ENDPOINT:-http://127.0.0.1:5173/api/preview-only}" --refineMode "${REFINE_MODE:-1}" --verbose && { if [ -n "$SLUG" ]; then npm run mcp:compare; else echo "Tip: set SLUG=... to auto-run visual compare"; fi; }'
scripts.mcp:preview:hi-fi:selected: sh -c 'npm run mcp:build && node ../tools/figma2code-mcp/dist/cli.js ingest --desktop ${SLUG:+--slug "$SLUG"} --mcp "${MCP_ENDPOINT:-http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp}" --post "${PREVIEW_ENDPOINT:-http://127.0.0.1:5173/api/preview-only}" --refineMode "${REFINE_MODE:-1}" --verbose && { if [ -n "$SLUG" ]; then npm run mcp:compare; else echo "Tip: set SLUG=... to auto-run visual compare"; fi; }'
scripts.mcp:preview:hi-fi:selected:refine: sh -c 'test -n "$SLUG" || { echo "Set SLUG=..."; exit 1; }; npm run mcp:build && node ../tools/figma2code-mcp/dist/cli.js ingest --desktop --slug "$SLUG" --mcp "${MCP_ENDPOINT:-http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp}" --post "${PREVIEW_ENDPOINT:-http://127.0.0.1:5173/api/preview-only}" --refineMode "${REFINE_MODE:-1}" --verbose && npm run mcp:compare && npm run mcp:refine'
